payload.summary: Caring Contacts: nothing checks screen wording against the prohibited-vocabulary list
payload.detail: The prohibited-language check runs against outgoing messages and the 24 frozen overlay rows only. No gate scans interface strings elsewhere in the workspace, so the ban on words such as high risk, safe, engagement score and risk score is currently policy held by people rather than by software. Copy review Part 5 item 2 records the same gap.
